title: For the patients who are diagnosed with SJS, how many of them have a normal
question:
For the patients who are diagnosed with SJS, how many of them have a normal level of total protein?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: diagnosed with SJS refers to Diagnosis = 'SJS'; normal level of total protein refers to TP > 6.0 and TP < 8.5;
